conbody.p: Activity, beside Settings in the project's rail, is the project's whole history, newest first, under a header for each day (Today, Yesterday, then the date). Each event reads as a sentence in the words Home uses: who did it, with their picture or a mark for an agent, a runner or the system; what they did, coloured like its dot on Home; and the thing they did it to, by its reference and title, as a link that opens it. Type narrows the log to one kind of event.
Click ▸ at the end of an event for its detail:

ul.li: a status change shows the old and new status as chips, with the version;
an edit shows what changed: the title and the text word by word, struck out in red and added in green, and each attribute before and after;
a link shows both ends and its type, such as TC-177 —verifies→ REQ-229;
a board move shows the column the card moved to;
a test result shows pass or fail, the test case and a link to the run;
an agent run shows its status, how long it took, what it cost and a link to the run;
anything else lists what was recorded with it.

conbody.p: Show raw event shows the event exactly as it is stored, for debugging.
